scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run --prefix backend start:dev" "npm run --prefix frontend dev"
scripts.build: npm run --prefix backend build && npm run --prefix frontend build
scripts.format: npm run --prefix backend format && npm run --prefix frontend format
scripts.lint: npm run --prefix backend lint && npm run --prefix frontend lint
scripts.test: npm run --prefix backend test -- --runInBand && npm run --prefix frontend test -- --run
